takeaway: One engineer said strong static charge on moving film stopped people, but no one measured the force, so the claim rests on his memory alone.
A user report that sounds impossible can be true, so test it and look for what changed; this one case rests on its teller's memory.
The early Apple III had real hardware faults, but no Apple record shows it told owners to drop the machine, and one case cannot prove the lesson.
Setting a problem aside helps a little, depending on the problem and the break, but no record from his time shows Archimedes had an insight in the bath.
The cut-the-tallest-plants gesture belongs to an older tyrant story, and no record tests whether removing prominent people keeps rulers in power.
Atari did bury unsold E.T. games with many other games, but the records tie its losses to a wider fall in game sales, not to one game.
Avid did reverse its Mac plan within months, but no record shows customers dumped stations or that a revolt caused the change, so that cause is unproven.
Amazon's own record shows AWS as a planned new business for developers, not a sale of spare capacity, so this case cannot support the lesson.
Bannister's run came after a war and lifetime bans on the two fastest milers, and four-minute miles then spread gradually, not at once, so the mind-limit story overstates it.
Nothing from 1988 to 1990 shows the duck decoy happened, and no study shows a planted flaw protects the rest of a work from review.
No record names the ranger, park or bin, and no study shows bear-proof bins fail because people cannot open them, so the lesson is unproven.
The beer-and-diapers link came from one unnamed retailer's data, and its study leader said the retailer never acted on it, so no profit gain is shown.
Kennedy's sentence did not mean doughnut to Berliners, who call the pastry Pfannkuchen, and the joke first appears in a 1983 novel, so his German did not need checking.
Adult films were sold on Betamax too, and the record says VHS won through recording time and industry alliances, not through adult content.
Records show Blackmagic wrote the software for one AJA card, the Kona SD, as a joint product, but they do not credit Petty or prove the founder-skill lesson.
The frog that sat still until it died had no brain, and frogs with brains tried to escape, so the experiment does not show living things ignore slow danger.
No one proved bumblebees cannot fly; a rough calculation used the wrong model of wings, and bee flight is now measured and explained.
No record shows a digger buried under a London basement, and the named builders say lifting small diggers out is cheap, so the story is unproven.
People do value things more after building them, as lab studies show, but no sales record shows cake mixes sold better because buyers added an egg.
The research was Rawlinson's 1976 Nottingham thesis, not a Cambridge study, and jumbled words slow reading, so letter order does matter somewhat.
The fever and tumour link came from hospital cases of erysipelas in New York and Germany, and trials give no firm proof that heat alone shrinks tumours.
At least one movement did clear an airstrip for an expected plane, but Feynman's other details are unconfirmed, and no study tests the copying-form lesson itself.
Carrots helped night vision only in people with vitamin A deficiency, and wartime rumour did spread about pilots eating them, but a propaganda origin is not established.
Early chance choices can fix standards for a long time, but the railway gauge traces to an 18th-century colliery waggonway, not Roman chariots.
No record shows the Nova sold badly because of its name, and a Mexican petrol called Nova Plus sold widely, so the name problem is unproven.
Rules do backfire when people game them, as Mexico City's driving ban did, but no record shows cobra breeding for a Delhi bounty.
Santa wore red before Coca-Cola's 1931 advertisements, so the company did not invent the red suit, and the claim that advertising makes tradition is unproven.
Columbus's experts knew the earth was round and doubted the voyage's distance and return, so the flat-earth scene is a later invention.
Cray did dig a tunnel when stumped, and setting a problem aside for simple tasks helps solve it on average, depending on the problem.
No record shows this crash or lawsuit; it was an unnamed urban legend by 1986, and the case and award were later invented.
Dantzig told this story himself and Neyman accepted the solutions, but no study shows that not knowing a problem is hard helps solve it.
No record shows any campus left unpaved so that walking paths could guide paving, and no test shows paving worn paths works better.
No medieval law found gives lords a right to peasant brides; the records show marriage fees, and the one legal text that names the act bans it.
Einstein earned top mathematics marks, and the exam he failed in 1895 was apparently failed on general subjects, so he does not show that early failure predicts nothing.
Einstein worked with help from his colleague Besso and built on Lorentz's work, and teams now produce most top research, so breakthroughs are not mostly lone work.
Einstein did decline a sound-speed question in 1921, but research shows that facts you remember help you read, learn and reason, so looking them up is not enough.
No record names a building where mirrors cut complaints, and studies are mixed on whether filling a wait improves satisfaction, so the story proves little.
Ellis Island inspectors copied names from passenger lists made abroad, and immigrants changed their own names later, so officials did not strip names at arrival.
Organisations did block USB ports with epoxy, but to stop data leaving, and no study measures how well blocking ports stops attacks.
Erasmus died in 1484, but the latrine detail first appears in 1689 and even that telling blames rock splinters, so the betrayal story is unproven.
All early tellings place the flip in simulation, not in flight, and the maker denied a bug, so the real-aircraft claim is unproven.
No record shows Faraday said this to Gladstone, but studies do show that basic research often feeds later patents.
Induction near power lines gives only milliwatts, and no record shows a farmer doing it or being prosecuted, so free power is unproven.
No Fidelity study of dead investors exists, but a large broker study shows households that traded most earned less than the market.
No five-monkey experiment is on record; Stephenson's real study differed, and later studies support only a weak, temporary persistence of arbitrary habits.
Three ancient texts tell this story differently and none is from Tiberius's time, though incumbent firms do sometimes buy and shut down rival drug projects.
Ford's $5 day followed very high turnover and absence, and the one study found it paid off through lower turnover, not through workers buying Fords.
No record backs the marshal event, and the cited regulation permits deadly force only in narrower cases than the post claims.
Heavy and light bodies do fall alike without air, as Apollo 15 showed, but only Viviani's later account places the drop at Pisa.
No record from Gandhi's lifetime shows the quip, but his own book Hind Swaraj criticised modern European civilisation in similar terms.
Pairing terms from both ends is a valid method, but the earliest account does not give the numbers 1 to 100 or Gauss's method.
A passenger's note led to questioning of an economist doing equations, but one case cannot show how often this happens, and people judge deception from behaviour only at chance level.
The jury convicted General Motors only of monopolising bus and supply sales, and Los Angeles streetcars were already giving way to buses, so "destroyed on purpose" is wrong.
Keep a backup channel that does not rely on your own systems, as Google's own reliability texts advise, but no record shows where Google hosts its backup IRC servers.
Strangers' tampered Halloween treats have not been shown to kill or seriously injure any child, so the danger is rare, while traffic is the real risk.
Freezing a failing drive has only single-case reports in its favour and experts warn it can make things worse, so back up first and do not count on it.
The lighting tests did not show that being watched raises output, only that many uncontrolled factors were at work, so do not cite them as proof of an observation effect.
No record shows a seat heater erasing tapes; strong permanent magnets can damage tape, so worry about those, and treat the heater story as unproven.
The exchange comes only from Vonnegut and no record shows Heller said it, so treat it as an unproven tale; income evidence does not show that more money stops helping.
No record shows Hemingway wrote the six words, and most readers in one survey saw a plain sale notice, so the moving-story claim is unproven.
Ancient sources do not say the Pythagoreans drowned Hippasus; they say the gods punished him or he was expelled, and one calls the drowning a parable.
Signing an honesty pledge first does not reduce cheating: the field result was fabricated and a large direct replication found no effect.
Hoover's own memoir tells this story, and no study tests it, so a careful reader can rely on his account but not on proof that forgiving mistakes works.
The word "bug" for a machine fault was in print by 1892, so the 1947 moth was a joke on an existing word and not its origin.
The Koshima monkeys learned potato washing slowly from one another over about ten years, with no sudden jump at a critical number and no spread to other troops.
No IBM record confirms the Black Team, and no open study shows that testers who aim to break software find more defects, so the claim is unproven.
No IBM record or letter has been found for this story, but evidence shows Japanese-run car plants had the best quality, though not a literal zero-defect standard.
The 1956 Act named the Interstate System for defense, but no law or standard ever required one mile in five to be straight for aircraft.
Labelling a weapon "less lethal" can lead to looser use and still kill, but the army's chief lawyer ruled in 2001 that this rifle is a live weapon.
No record from 1832 shows Jackson said the famous line, but his private letter and later events show a ruling needs the executive branch to enforce it.
The jam study matches its published paper, but a meta-analysis found almost no average choice-overload effect, so "more options means fewer choices" is not established.
The fish tank story comes from an unnamed source who could not vouch for it, though goal-setting research shows specific, hard goals raise performance.
Crockford told this story himself, and the Free Software Foundation lists the JSON licence as not free because of that one line.
Kekulé himself described the half-sleep vision in 1890, but his papers do not mention it, and sleep research supports only a limited role after hard work.
Kildall flew on a scheduled business trip and returned that afternoon, and talks had already stalled over IBM's non-disclosure agreement, so one missed meeting did not clearly cost the deal.
The Fort Hood story has no record, but thermal imaging did find heat from grow lamps in a documented case, though cooler LED lamps may defeat it now.
Few people saw the attack and some helped, and filmed street conflicts show bystanders usually help, so a crowd does not reliably prevent help.
Kodak patented the digital camera publicly and sold digital cameras from 1991, so its fall does not show that incumbents suppress new technology.
Herschel's diary records no "no need of that hypothesis" line, so the quote is unproven; computed Solar System models run on physical law but are not strictly stable.
Lemmings do not follow a crowd to suicide; eyewitnesses saw them drown by accident while dispersing across water, and the story says nothing about people.
McArthur Wheeler's lemon juice plan is documented, and studies show that people with the lowest skill often rate themselves far above their real rank.
The saying was told of an unnamed "great princess" before Marie Antoinette reached France, and her own 1775 letter shows concern for the people.
No single fire ended the Library of Alexandria; a fire in 48 BC burned books but the collections survived and faded over centuries because nobody recopied the papyrus.
The lighthouse exchange never happened and is an old joke, so it proves nothing; check facts before insisting that others must give way.
No record made at the time shows audiences fleeing the train film; 1896 viewers felt surprise and strong depth while knowing they watched shadows.
One missing overbar in handwritten guidance equations, with a beacon failure, destroyed Mariner 1, so one small slip can wreck a costly mission, but FORTRAN was not to blame.
Waiting longer as a preschooler predicted success only weakly and in one test condition, and not at all by the late 40s, so the link is not established.
The Liebeck case involved severe burns and hundreds of earlier complaints, the judge cut the award to $640,000, and most winning awards are modest.
Mehrabian's 7-38-55 figures describe how people judge liking from one-word messages about feelings, not how much of any message the words carry.
The two insiders agree an encrypted Microsoft Bob copy was on Windows XP discs as a check, but they differ on its size, and the effect on copying is untested.
Microsoft's $150 million was about a tenth of Apple's cash, and Apple's filing said its resources would cover the next twelve months, so it did not clearly rescue Apple.
A known memory leak is acceptable only when the run is short and bounded and the designers plan for it, as the one unnamed missile team reportedly did.
Mozart's own letters and manuscripts show sketches, erasures and cuts, and the famous "letter to Baron von P." is a fabrication, so effortless perfection is a myth.
No ownership record shows a Musk family emerald mine, only Errol Musk's changing account, so the claim that it explains Musk's wealth is unproven.
Briggs's 1985 paper argues only that Indian grammarians' paraphrase resembles AI semantic nets; it does not say Sanskrit suits computers best, and NASA did not claim it.
New College did not plant oaks at its founding for the hall; the oaks came from woods it acquired in 1441, so the story shows no plan centuries ahead.
Newton's own writing does not mention an apple, and his account of gravity describes about twenty years of work, so the story of a sudden flash is unproven.
Cat holes in doors were recorded long before Newton, and the first tellings name nobody, so the story does not show that Newton lacked common sense.
The History of Parliament shows Newton was not an active member, with four committees and one vote in 1689, though no record proves his only words were about a window.
Nobel had no wife, and his will gives no reason for leaving out mathematics, so the affair story is false and no record shows a grudge.
Nordstrom's tire story first appeared as a rule, not an event, but evidence shows lenient return policies raise purchases more than they raise returns.
No bug made Gandhi nuke-happy in the original game, but unsigned integers really do wrap around to huge values, so such underflow bugs are real.
Two textbooks describe an NYPD sting called Operation Lucky Bag, but no record confirms the dates, arrests or outcomes, so the rest is unproven.
No named trader receiving a cargo is on record, but futures held to expiry do require physical delivery, so close or roll positions before expiry.
Staff saw Oscar at more than 25 deaths, but nobody counted the times he sat with residents who lived, so his power to predict death is unproven.
Verizon's own account says a developer outsourced his job and a log check found it, but no other record confirms the case, and log review finds few breaches.
Pareto studied income tax records, not pea pods, and Juran named the 80/20 rule; heavy-tailed splits are real in some data, but no law fixes them at 80/20.
The $435 hammer and $640 toilet cover prices were real and later cut, though the "seat" was a plastic cover for a whole aircraft toilet.
Courts held Schmeiser liable because he knowingly saved and planted resistant seed on about 1,000 acres, not because pollen or seed blew onto his field.
Harlow recorded a real personality change after Gage's injury, and modern lesion studies link such change to the front of the brain, but no record shows it lasted for life.
Police can trick suspects with false evidence, and such tactics can produce false confessions, but no record shows the photocopier trick happened, and Radnor's police chief denied it.
Quick expert work does rest on years of practice, but no record shows Picasso said this; Whistler said something similar at his 1878 trial.
The famous $200,000 table was about a proposed rollover rule for millions of vehicles, but the court still found Ford delayed Pinto tank fixes for cost reasons.
Governments did secretly test drugs on unwitting people, but no record shows a Polybius game existed in 1981, so the mind-control arcade story is unproven.
The 1997 Pokemon episode sent about 700 people, mostly children, to hospital, and flashing screens can cause seizures, though many milder cases may have been mass psychogenic illness.
The pot roast story is a stock humorous anecdote, not a real family event, but studies show children do copy adults' needless steps without asking why.
No record shows any class was graded this way, and the source may be a photography class; research supports only that people who make more also make more good work.
Records show QWERTY grew from telegraph-speed demonstrations, not a plan to slow typists, and the claim that Dvorak is clearly better rests on weak tests.
Loose or rusty metal can pick up radio signals, but nothing shows a bedstead can make audible sound alone, and the one family story names no place or date.
Crush injuries can turn deadly after release, but no record shows a railway worker dying this way, and the story is folklore that its collector could not verify.
Rat Park rats drank less morphine than isolated rats but did not refuse it, and later tests failed to repeat the gap, so the lesson about addiction is unproven.
Lasers aimed into a crowd can injure eyes, but at this 2008 festival between 12 and about 60 people had retinal bleeding and partial sight loss, not blindness for all.
Sound can disturb a hard drive, as a 2018 laboratory study shows, but the Rhythm Nation event rests on one unnamed person's account, and the drives were disrupted, not damaged.
The Roddenberry line appears first in a 1996 magazine paraphrase, no text under his name has been found, and no study can test the prediction about future attitudes.
No Roman text describes engineers standing under their bridges, and the idea that personal risk improves building is ancient, but no study shows that it works.
The 47-ton figure rests only on Taylor's own accounts, which changed between 1903 and 1911, so the claim of a four-fold rise in output is unproven.
Seinfeld says the calendar chain was not his idea, and a habit study found that one missed day barely slowed habit forming.
The sesame seed story began as an invented example in a 1985 consulting book, and no real burger chain is known to have done it.
No copy of the Shackleton advertisement has been found, and the applicants answered a Times letter, so the claim that harsh honest advertisements draw better recruits is unproven.
Only Kennedy's own story, told from 1960, links a shoeshine boy to his selling before the crash, and surveys show weak evidence that crowd optimism signals a market top.
The spoons joke circulated in 1901 and 1908 with other speakers, and no record shows Friedman said it, but history shows machines have not cut overall employment.
British officers deliberately gave smallpox-infected items to Delaware envoys at Fort Pitt in 1763, but no record shows the gift caused the epidemic.
Snow showed cholera spreads through contaminated water, but the outbreak was already nearly over when the handle came off, so the handle did not end it.
No record shows the soap box event happened, and air blasts that remove rejected packages are standard engineered equipment, so the contrast with expensive fixes is weak.
No real factory is known to have made one giant nail; the earliest version is a satirical cartoon, and the evidence does not show that crude targets always fail.
NASA did not fund the space pen; Fisher paid for it and sold it to NASA for about $6, and the Soviets bought it too.
No record made at the time shows spitting, and a 1971 survey found 82 percent of veterans said peers who did not serve were friendly, though cooler than before.
By Stallman's own account the printer refusal only prepared him, and the break-up of the AI Lab community led him to start GNU in 1983.
The Stanford guards were coached to act tough, and a later BBC study found guards did not turn cruel on their own, so a role alone does not do it.
The chalk bill joke dates from before Steinmetz's death and was attached to him decades later, so no record shows he sent such a bill.
Records confirm Mel Kaye and his blackjack program, but the reversed test and overflow loop rest on Nather's memory alone, and no study shows such code is harder to maintain.
The Army tank project was real but its results were classified, and no record shows the sunny-versus-cloudy failure, though models really can learn accidental features of their data.
Target did build a pregnancy model, but the angry father story rests on one unnamed employee, so it is unproven that the model caused it.
The 1993 study found selected violin students had practised about 10,000 hours by adulthood, but practice explains little of skill differences and guarantees no expertise.
The 2008 Tesla leaker wrote his own letter and was not caught by a spacing code, though per-copy marks can identify a leaker when the marked copy itself leaks.
Tulip prices did crash in 1637, but records find no ruined bankrupts and no damage to the Dutch economy, so this case does not show that manias ruin many people.
Van Halen's rider really contained the no-brown-M&Ms clause, and a small hidden check can reveal whether someone read instructions, as research on instruction checks shows.
No record shows the vanilla ice cream complaint happened, and the cause changes between tellings, though a hot engine refusing to restart is a real fault.
Vicary's sales rise rests only on his own company's figures, the theatre's executives said sales did not change, and hidden cues sway only people already in need.
The vodka-and-meat output was first printed as a joke labelled apocryphal, and no real system is known to have produced it, though early machine translation was often wrong.
Wald's 1943 memoranda show that damage on returning planes undercounts hits on the most vulnerable parts, though no record shows the military's armour plan or his advice.
The hell well story names no real well, and the deep Soviet well showed ordinary rock warming with depth, with no hollow space and no sound recorded.
No 1876 Western Union memo has been found, and the company entered the telephone business within two years, so the tale of a company dismissing the telephone is unproven.
A reporter wrote that Sutton said banks are where the money is, Sutton denied it in 1976, and no record settles it.
No Yale class was polled about written goals, and the one small test found only modest help from writing goals, not lifetime wealth.
Apple saw PARC's work under a deal in which Xerox invested in Apple, and a study found Xerox managed its spin-offs deliberately, so the story of theft and blindness fails.
